pr.body:
## Purpose

Readonly MCP Git tools already admit ordinary linked worktrees when both the worktree and actual parent repository are explicitly trusted. Their installed-package verifier did not exercise that useful native layout. This PR adds real SDK/stdio coverage and makes the existing installed Git gate require **24/24 cases**: the preserved 18-case boundary fixture plus six ordinary clone/worktree cases.

Refs #235 and parent #66. Session `MTERM-WEB-20261109T131339Z-resume-a9287b3c`; OpenAI / GPT-6 Astra Pro, self-reported. Qualified base `3077a7fe1927d1ae17aab99570832d6f9e1e3819`. Local independently reviewed checkpoint `5f143c9cc13d6dff8582c7676af468739c6d6a38`; exact tree `c82839e6b51182bcfc3820d65aabe4716c8491c4`.

## Changes and behavior

- Exercise status and distinct staged/unstaged diffs through actual SDK clients in an ordinary independent clone and untouched Git-created linked worktree, including a nested path.
- Require both correct roots; missing or unrelated metadata grants remain denied, and ordinary file reads cannot expose Git metadata.
- Check exact readonly tool inventory, capability/root bounds, complete per-case byte manifests and observed natural child closure. `networkListener:false` is a reported capability, without an independent OS listener census.
- Extend only the existing Git block in the installed verifier; retain both fixture hashes, module binding checks and bounded execution. Production Git/root behavior, dependencies, workflows and self-host verification are unchanged.
- Append bounded evidence to CLI-266/283/284 and preserve every protected roadmap field. Also retain completed PR #234 source-delivery history, with #232 open for live provider/connected cleanup.

## Executed validation and independent review

- Frozen first source run **6/6 GREEN** on unchanged production; additional coverage with no reproduced defect or artificial RED.
- Independent source run **6/6**; root combined new6 + legacy18 + existing Git/MCP8 **32/32**, zero failures/skips/cancellations/todos, empty stderr and unchanged execution bindings.
- Explicit roadmap review/render/check, normal build/parity, typecheck, format and whitespace gates: all seven actual exits0. Source fingerprint `be5379955eb4aaa9dc625bcf7a2b9b59027f7be41498b121047b88ff647cd93f` over183 entries. The final documentation correction passed roadmap/whitespace consistency checks without a product rerun.
- Immutable worker review CLEAR: `ea034c0b1d3e8b620a6bad94b78815a6fa7d76895c76a56eb8eb502f98e1df4b`.
- Independent final shared review CLEAR: `93fcc0b42add3310b4895bb44143129907888578d7bc5df8c95520257b596aab`, all87 checks and16 changed file bindings. It corrected an over-specific manifest entry count; raw evidence remains intact.

**Local installed qualification is NOT RUN.** Two offline installation attempts failed before tests on distinct absent cache records. Their packs used `--ignore-scripts`; neither is normal prepack/full-verifier acceptance. No third install or fabricated cache metadata was used. A first root wrapper with a lost execution result remains UNKNOWN/unqualified; the later retained32-case run is separate. The known local Unix-socket limit supplies no full-local/quick PASS.

## Delivery and limits

All six exact-candidate hosted jobs, including actual installed24 in each of the five package lanes, are mandatory before ordinary expected-head merge. The actual merge commit must separately pass all six main jobs. Final acceptance is recorded separately after actual-main qualification.

Standing owner authorization in `docs/OWNER_AUTHORIZATION.md` covers normal qualified delivery without recurring manual approval. Historical branches and claims are preserved. Broad #66, malformed pointers, discovery configuration, alternates, implicit fetch and concurrent writers remain outside this coverage. No provider, Windows, deployment, production bridge, paid/model or unrelated-project operation is included.

Published candidate: `fc9a0f58cde51b7f3143b0ed06e2fa04188d8b83`; verified to have the exact reviewed local tree.

## Tracker timing correction

Raw issue and timeline reads show that this tracker was already marked closed at **2026-11-09T21:13:17Z**, two seconds after PR #236 merged. My earlier post-merge statement that the issue remained open was incorrect. The closing event has no commit association, so its exact cause is not established by that event. The original PR description contained a closing-keyword sequence inside a negative sentence; that is a plausible automatic trigger. I removed that sentence while preserving the original description and readbacks in the delivery receipts.

**Final acceptance was recorded at 21:24:03Z**, after the independent actual-main audit and root byte verification; the implementation claim was released at **21:24:04Z**. The later explicit state update returned the earlier closure timestamp. Tracker closure at merge did not establish actual-main acceptance. All six actual-main jobs and their evidence were separately qualified before final acceptance.

The currently completed state is correct and remains intact. The original event, earlier comments, candidate/main evidence and original PR wording are retained. Future PR descriptions will use neutral references and separate acceptance language, avoiding closing-keyword sequences until tracker closure is intended.
